gaps.sentence: I'm not used to ___ such spicy food.
The guests had no sooner arrived ___ the fire alarm went off.
gaps.explanation: 'No sooner' is always followed by 'than', never 'when'.

gaps.sentence: She made the cake ___, without any help at all.
gaps.explanation: 'She made it herself' — the reflexive stresses she did it alone.

gaps.sentence: All the tickets ___ sold out by noon.
gaps.explanation: Past perfect passive: had been + participle (before the stated past moment).

gaps.sentence: It was ___ a lovely evening that nobody wanted to leave.
gaps.explanation: 'Such a lovely evening that …' — 'so' would go directly before an adjective.

gaps.sentence: ___ of the two passwords works — try the other one.
gaps.hint: not one and not the other
gaps.explanation: 'Neither of the two' = not either of them.
